indices.name: refseq16s
indices.title: NCBI RefSeq 16S rRNA (Bacteria + Archaea)
indices.description: RefSeq Targeted Loci 16S rRNA sequences with NCBI taxonomy. For 16S amplicon reads.

example.label: 5,000 simulated 150 bp 16S reads from a 9-species mock community

indices.name: gtdb_ssu
indices.title: GTDB R232 16S rRNA of species representatives
indices.description: 16S rRNA genes of GTDB R232 species-representative genomes (Bacteria + Archaea) with GTDB taxonomy, unfiltered. Some representative genomes carry contaminating 16S genes and GTDB splits many genera (e.g. Enterococcus, Enterococcus_C), so expect more reads to stop above genus than with RefSeq 16S.

example.label: 5,000 simulated 150 bp 16S reads from a 9-species mock community

indices.name: silva_ssu
indices.title: SILVA 138.2 SSU Ref NR99
indices.description: SILVA 138.2 small-subunit rRNA (16S/18S) non-redundant reference with SILVA taxonomy (resolves to genus). For 16S/18S amplicon reads across all domains.

example.label: 5,000 simulated 150 bp 16S reads from a 9-species mock community

indices.name: refseq_fungi
indices.title: NCBI RefSeq fungal ITS, 18S and 28S rRNA
indices.description: RefSeq Targeted Loci fungal ITS, 18S and 28S rRNA sequences with NCBI taxonomy. For fungal (mycobiome) amplicon reads.

example.label: 5,000 simulated 150 bp ITS reads from an 8-species fungal mock community

indices.name: refseq_viral
indices.title: NCBI RefSeq viral genomes (excluding phages)
indices.description: RefSeq viral genomes with NCBI taxonomy, excluding bacteriophages (Caudoviricetes and sequences named phage). For shotgun reads from eukaryotic viruses.

example.label: 5,000 simulated 150 bp shotgun reads from 8 human viruses

indices.name: refseq_viral_prot
indices.title: NCBI RefSeq viral proteins (including phages)
indices.description: All RefSeq viral proteins with NCBI taxonomy, bacteriophages included. Reads are translated and matched at the protein level, which finds viruses too divergent for nucleotide matching. Large: plan for about 1 GB of browser memory.

example.label: 5,000 simulated 150 bp shotgun reads from 8 human viruses and 3 bacteriophages

indices.name: swissprot
indices.title: UniProtKB/Swiss-Prot (all domains, protein)
indices.description: Curated Swiss-Prot proteins from all domains of life, with NCBI taxonomy. Reads are translated and matched at the protein level. Broad but sparse (mostly well-studied organisms), so calls below phylum or family are reliable only for well-studied taxa. Large: plan for about 1 GB of browser memory.

example.label: 5,000 simulated 150 bp shotgun reads from 6 bacterial genomes and yeast
